**~1,080 occurrences across 94 files** — mostly the four service repos (accounts, orders, billing, notify, analytics), each with matching service/repo/route layers.

Four spots must stay `account_id`:

- `docs\openapi.yaml` — public API contract, fields marked "Frozen field name," renaming breaks every client
- `lib\serialize.js:8` — wire-format map, comment says frozen by that same contract
- `vendor\reporting-sdk\src\*` (schema.js, client.js, query.js, export.js) — vendored/generated, "Do not edit," gets overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`
- `migrations\*.sql` (10 files) — already applied in production; editing history breaks the down step and renames nothing in real databases

`lib\audit.js` is a judgment call — it stitches `account_id` from `fields` into log lines, worth confirming with platform team whether stored audit records get parsed by key.

Safe to rename: the 90-odd `services\*` files (accounts, billing, notify, orders, analytics) — internal-only column usage. Plan: rename internal usages, add a new migration to rename the DB column, keep `serialize.js`/`openapi.yaml` mapping internal `owner_id` → public `account_id`.
